hypotheses.R1_routing_value_recomposition_is_exact: Routing and value Shapley source terms recompose the full final-destination delta with relative L2 error at most 1e-5 and propagated-logit error at most 1e-4.
hypotheses.R2_attention_mass_is_conserved: Per-head final-row attention-pattern changes sum to at most 1e-5 in absolute value.
hypotheses.R3_pre_edit_value_changes_are_causally_z: Value-side source changes strictly before the edited token have maximum absolute write magnitude at most 1e-6.
hypotheses.R4_routing_dominates_behavior: Routing receives at least 0.50 behavioral Shapley projection in every condition.
hypotheses.R5_value_changes_are_sometimes_material: At least one condition gives value changes at least 0.25 behavioral Shapley projection.
hypotheses.R6_isolated_routing_and_value_effects_ad: The sum of isolated routing and value logit effects has at least 0.90 Fisher fidelity to their joint finite effect in every condition.
hypotheses.R7_state_and_behavior_agree_on_the_large: Routing versus value has the same larger absolute allocation under state and behavioral metrics in every condition.
hypotheses.R8_large_source_edges_are_mostly_routing: Within adaptive state-norm top-32 sources, routing receives at least 0.60 mean state projection.
hypotheses.R9_routing_has_structurally_balanced_sig: For each head, positive and negative attention-pattern change masses agree within 1e-4.
hypotheses.R10_routing_dominance_transfers_ood: Each layer's mean routing behavioral allocation differs from FineWeb by at most 0.15 on both OOD corpora.
